title: Scope approval-disclaimer duplication to specific prompt families.
description: The repeated approval disclaimer does not appear on the stricter two-bullet source-link prompt, which indicates the bug is prompt-family-specific rather than universal. Capture the conditions that trigger duplicate structured-write warnings, keep the final answer free of repeated boilerplate, and ensure the response stays concise. Acceptance criteria: the disclaimer appears at most once on the affected prompt families, the unaffected prompt family remains clean, and the trace still preserves the reason for the warning. Validation: rerun the repro prompts and confirm only the known prompt family reproduces the duplication.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Evidence: the exact two-bullet source-link prompt finished cleanly without the repeated approval disclaimer, even though related multi-source prompts reproduced the duplication.
